We need to produce a tool call with proper JSON. Let's do:

<thought>We will search for templates that match the product SMILES and involve breaking aldehydes and carboxylic acids and forming C-C double bonds and carboxylic acid.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(N(S(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)c3ccccc3)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic acid"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
